about_the_game:
Full Description:

In a wondrous world where magic intertwines with the lives of extraordinary creatures and people, many legends have been passed down through the ages. One such legend spoke of a magical stone capable of granting any wish of its holder. This stone, imbued with ancient power, was guarded by a goddess whose location remained hidden from prying eyes.

It was said that the path to the coveted artifact was long and dangerous, for the key to uncovering its location was protected by fearless warrior maidens. Each of them possessed remarkable strength and would never give away their secrets to a stranger. Many brave souls had attempted the journey, but their fates were shrouded in darkness — no one ever heard from those who dared to challenge.

But one day, a new hero appeared. His name was Toshi, and he was determined to test his strength. Toshi had rare courage and an unyielding will, and his goal was as ambitious as it was dangerous — immortality and domination over the entire magical world.

Thus began his fateful odyssey. Resolute and ready for any challenge, he took his first step toward the adventures that would change his life and, perhaps, the entire world.

Game Features:

The game combines elements of the “match-3” genre and visual novel storytelling.

To unlock more details about the characters, you must defeat them in battles that are based on the “match-3” system and are influenced by the heroines’ attributes.

Victory requires not only creating chains of stones but also strategically using abilities and items.

Your choices will determine the future of these girls.

short_description: A match-3 genre game with elements of the Japanese GalGame and visual novel genres, where the player must complete the story and defeat the guardians of the “Wish Stone.” After defeating each beauty, the player will have the opportunity to interact with each of the lovely girls.
